text_block_list.text:
One day, while I'm walking around the
school
grounds...
CRASH!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Ah! I'm so sorry! Are you okay?!

Kitasan Black bumps into me and drops
her
belongings, scattering her stuff
everywhere. As I
go to pick it all up...

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: Kita, did you drop this cold medicine?

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
And this vitamin drink... Are you feeling
sick,
Kita?

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Oh, that stuff's for Dia, not me. I'm
heading to
visit her in the infirmary.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
She has a race soon, so it's the worst
timing. I
know snacks won't help her
much, but I can't just
sit by and do
nothing.

text_block_list.name: Umamusume B
text_block_list.text:
How sweet of you. Sports drinks will
help too!
Here, have mine!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Oh, are you sure?

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Take this apple compote too. I was just
about to
give you some anyway.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
It's made from the apples you helped me
carry
home the other day.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Oh, I remember that! Thank you so
much! I'm sure
she'll love this!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Hey, take this too! Just a little
thank-you from
Golshi!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Oh, there you are, Kita! I found that
thing you
wanted! ☆

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: This is so much. Are you sure?!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Well, you're always helping me out. It's
about
time I paid you back!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Thank you so much, everyone!
choice_data_list: It'd be tough alone—I'll carry it.
It'd be tough alone, right? I'll carry it.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Okay, I'm here... Dia, are you awake?
How are
you feeling?

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Kita? Thanks for coming...
choice_data_list: I'll leave the get-well gift right here.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: ACHOO!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
You okay? Feeling chilly? I bought you
the cold
medicine you usually take!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Everyone sent along some tasty food, so
eat up,
drink up, and rest up, okay?

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
...Sorry about all this, Kita. You really
went out of
your way for me.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
What are you talking about? I'm doing
this
because I want to!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
You have a race coming up, remember? I
want to
leave you in the dust!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
But there's no point if I don't beat you
fair and
square. I won't accept the win
unless you're in
tip-top shape!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Kita...

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
See, I've got my own reasons too! So just
rest up
and let me handle this!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
See, I've got my own reasons too! So just
rest up
and let me handle this!
choice_data_list: We need to get that treated quickly.
We can't let all this energy beat us!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: ...Hehe, I suppose you're right.
choice_data_list: We need to get that treated quickly.
We need to get that treated quickly.
We can't let all this energy beat us!
We can't let all this energy beat us!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
I want to go head-to-head with you one
more
time... No, over and over again!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Dia!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
After all you've done for me... I'll
definitely be in
perfect condition for the
race!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Yesss! Me too!

Together with the light from the sunset,
the
warmth of their bond fills the whole
room.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Of course! I won't let Kita outshine me!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
I'll eat my fill and get plenty of rest...
Then I'll feel
even better than before!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Gotcha! Okay!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Satono Diamond has just entered the
gate, and
she's aiming for a full
recovery!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Hehe. Apple compote, carrot porridge,
cold
medicine... I'm all set!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Will sheer good health be enough for
her to
outrun Kitasan Black? The race to
find out is
about to begin!

Laughter and delicious smells fill the
sunset-lit
infirmary.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Okay! I'll make sure to eat my fill and
recover!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
...Hm? What's that bottle over there?
"Golshi
Mix"?

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Huh? Oh, this must be that mystery
drink Gold
Ship gave me!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
"Concentrated Antibiotic Umacillin"?
Wow, there
are so many things here I've
never seen before...

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Whoa, whoa! Hold up a sec, Dia!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Let's start with the safe stuff, shall we?!
